title: Top Office Chairs for Long Workdays & Back Pain (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected the top picks from CNET, PCMag, and Expert Reviews, choosing the one that appears in the most detailed source (Herman Miller Aeron).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in any source, so no cost information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a long day at the desk where you need solid lumbar support and a breathable mesh back—this chair gives that. It offers adjustable headrest and seat depth, making it a good fit for people who sit for hours. The main catch is its high cost, which is not mentioned in the sources but is implied by its premium status.
